support.title: Help and Troubleshooting
support.description: State-based recovery guidance for common issues.
support.disclaimer: This guidance does not guarantee outcomes and does not authorize any action on your behalf.

walletNetwork.title: Wallet and Network
walletNetwork.description: Resolve wallet connection and network mismatch issues.

steps.connect: Connect your wallet using the Connect Wallet button.
steps.checkChain: Confirm the connected chain matches the expected network.
steps.switchManually: If the network is wrong, switch networks manually in your wallet.

walletNetwork.notes: No network switch is performed automatically.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: Recovery guidance for rejected, replaced, and reverted transactions.

rejected.title: Rejected
rejected.description: The transaction was rejected in your wallet before submission.

steps.review: Review the transaction details before retrying.
steps.retry: Retry the action and sign in your wallet if you choose to proceed.

replaced.title: Replaced
replaced.description: The transaction was replaced by another transaction with the same nonce.

steps.verify: Verify the replacing transaction hash in the explorer.
steps.wait: Wait for the replacing transaction to confirm.

reverted.title: Reverted
reverted.description: The transaction executed on-chain but reverted.

steps.reviewReason: Review the revert reason in the explorer.
steps.adjust: Adjust inputs or conditions before attempting again.

indexing.title: Indexing Delay and Reorg
indexing.description: Understand delays between on-chain confirmation and indexed projections.

steps.wait: Wait for the indexer to catch up.
steps.refresh: Refresh the view after a short interval.
steps.verifyChain: Verify the on-chain state in an explorer if delays persist.

indexing.notes: Indexed projections may lag behind on-chain finality.

evidence.title: Evidence Availability
evidence.description: What to do when evidence is not yet available.

steps.wait: Wait for evidence to be published and indexed.
steps.checkSource: Check the original source for availability.
steps.verify: Verify the content digest matches the expected artifact.

claims.title: Claims
claims.description: Recovery guidance for claim submission and state issues.

steps.checkState: Check the current claim state and transaction hash.
steps.waitIndex: Wait for indexing if the transaction is confirmed.
steps.retry: Retry only if no transaction was submitted.

steps.checkState: Check the verification state and associated transaction.
steps.escalate: Escalate through approved channels if the state remains inconsistent.

steps.checkState: Check the dispute state and any associated transactions.

steps.checkState: Check the reward state and associated transactions.
steps.escalate: Escalate through approved channels if the state remains inconsistent.
